jei.castingtools.modifier.information:
The Modifier can be used to make your tools and equipment more powerful.

The modifier uses Molten Experience as a fuel as well as either another fluid, an item or a Fluid and Item to apply a modifier.

Standing on the Modifier will consume your experience and insert into the internal experience tank
modifier.castingtools.beheading.descript: Valid mobs will always drop their head when killed
modifier.castingtools.excavation.descrip: Increases the area of effect when mining, allowing you to mine multiple blocks at once
modifier.castingtools.fortune.descriptio: Increases the chance of receiving more items when mining certain block, like Ores
modifier.castingtools.ignite.description: Sets mobs on fire when hit
modifier.castingtools.knockback.descript: Increases the knockback to mobs when hit
modifier.castingtools.lifesteal.descript: Heals you for a portion of the damage dealt to mobs
modifier.castingtools.looting.descriptio: Increases the chance of mobs dropping more items when killed
modifier.castingtools.protection.descrip: Reduces incoming damage from mobs and other sources
modifier.castingtools.repairing.descript: Repairs your tools and equipment over time
modifier.castingtools.sharpness.descript: Increases the damage dealt to mobs
modifier.castingtools.silk_touch.descrip: Allows you to mine blocks and receive the block itself instead of its usual drops, such as mining stone and receiving a stone block instead of cobblestone
modifier.castingtools.sticky.description: Stick to walls just like a spider
modifier.castingtools.teleporting.descri: Teleports you to a random location within a 5 block radius when you right click. Doesn't require any items in your inventory
modifier.castingtools.torch_placer.descr: Places a torch when you right click. Doesn't require torches in your inventory
modifier.castingtools.unbreaking.descrip: Reduces the chance of you tool taking damage when used
